verdict.rationale: Deepgram provides all core building blocks — prompting, voice/LLM selection, telephony via Twilio bridging, and a single WebSocket API — that together could plausibly get a developer to a first live call quickly. However, the telephony path requires standing up your own server to bridge Twilio audio to the Voice Agent WebSocket, which is nontrivial integration work rather than a turnkey 'phone number in one hour' flow, and there's no first-party quickstart or time-to-first-call benchmark cited. missing for 10: an end-to-end quickstart/tutorial demonstrating full setup within an hour, evidence of a managed/no-code telephony number provisioning path, and independent hands-on confirmation of setup speed.
